description: This file defines API route handlers for managing requirement catalog items using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting catalog items, leveraging SQLAlchemy for database interactions.

methods.name: tuple[int,int] _paginate_params(page: int, per_page: int)
methods.description: Calculates offset and limit for pagination based on page number and items per page.

methods.name: list_catalog_items( q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Search text over key/title/description"), category: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by category"), page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1, description="Page number (1-based)"), per_page: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list catalog items with optional search and pagination.

methods.name: create_catalog_item( payload: RequirementCatalogCreate, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session) )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new catalog item ensuring 'key' uniqueness.

methods.name: get_catalog_item(item_id: int, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific catalog item by ID.

methods.name: update_catalog_item( item_id: int, payload: RequirementCatalogUpdate, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session) )
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update fields of an existing catalog item.

methods.name: delete_catalog_item(item_id: int, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a catalog item by ID.
